usage: Use 花莖 to mean the stalk or stem of a flower or plant. It sounds natural in gardening, botany, and school science.
This is a countable noun in Cantonese, so you can say 一條花莖 or 幾條花莖 when you are talking about more than one.
It is a neutral, everyday word, but it is more common in plant-related descriptions than in casual conversation.
Learners often mix up 花莖 and 葉柄: 花莖 is the main stem of the flower or plant, while 葉柄 is the leaf stalk.
